title: Match file owner to a reference file
summary: Use chown with the --reference flag to copy the ownership (user and group) from one file to another.

steps.explain: Use the --reference flag to set the owner and group of the target file to match those of the reference file.

placeholders.name: REFERENCE_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file whose ownership you want to copy

placeholders.name: FILE_OR_DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the file or directory to change

rollback.explain: To undo, manually set the original owner and group.

placeholders.name: FILE_OR_DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the file or directory

warnings: This changes both user and group ownership to match the reference file.
